subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin compatibility checks always evaluate against the installed target package version during current-process update and convergence, and should the linked issue remain open or be split for the newer unknown-host startup variant?
rationale: The code change affects upgrade-time plugin compatibility decisions, and the linked issue now contains evidence for a related but broader steady-state host-version detection failure that this patch does not cover.

options.title: Accept the narrow update-handoff contract
options.body: Land after fresh validation if maintainers agree post-core checks should match the package that will run after restart, while preserving separate tracking for the startup unknown-host variant.

options.title: Narrow closure scope before merge
options.body: Remove or revise the closing relationship or create a linked follow-up so the broader host-version startup report is not closed by this merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader host-version fix
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical fix that covers both post-core update handoff and steady-state gateway host-version detection.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow update-handoff contract
recommendation.body: Land after fresh validation if maintainers agree post-core checks should match the package that will run after restart, while preserving separate tracking for the startup unknown-host variant.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent release/update and Feishu package history around the compatibility and update surfaces, making them the best available routing candidate for the source-of-truth decision.
